relations.subject: Geo Widengren
relations.evidence: Geo Widengren (24 April 1907 – 28 January 1996) was a Swedish historian of religions, professor of history of religions at Uppsala University

relations.subject: Geo Widengren
relations.evidence: Widengren studied history of religions at Stockholm University for his mentor Tor Andrae until 1933

relations.subject: Geo Widengren
relations.evidence: He had studied Assyriology in Copenhagen and Iranian Studies in Uppsala for H.S. Nyberg.

relations.subject: Anders Hultgård
relations.evidence: His pupil Anders Hultgård has published In memoriam Geo Widengren (1907–1996).

relations.subject: Alessandro Bausani
relations.evidence: Widengren's position was continued and developed in many works by Alessandro Bausani and Shaul Shaked.
